description: This header defines utilities for integrating Arm Compute Library (ACL) quantized operations within PyTorch, including classes for static and dynamic quantized matrix multiplication, addition, and weight handling, specifically optimized for ACL acceleration on ARM architectures.

classes.name: QuantMatmul
classes.description: Abstract interface for ACL quantized matrix multiplication, supporting validation and configuration.

classes.name: DynamicQuantMatmul
classes.description: Implements dynamic quantized matrix multiplication with optional ReLU fusion.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightsACL
classes.description: Extends PackedLinearWeightsOnednn to support ACL-accelerated quantized linear weights, with caching and application methods.

methods.name: QuantMatmul
methods.description: Constructor for abstract quantized matrix multiplication interface.

methods.name: DynamicQuantMatmul
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, validate, and configure methods for dynamic quantized matmul.

methods.name: StaticQuantMatmul
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, validate, and configure methods for static quantized matmul.

methods.name: QuantAdd
methods.description: Constructor, validate, and configure methods for quantized addition.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeightsACL
methods.description: Constructor, application methods for dynamic and relu- fused dynamic, apply with scale and zero point, cache management, and creation of ACL quant matmul instances.
